description: Measured case dimensions (width x depth) of keyboards reviewed on HLPlanet. Search by name ("NuPhy Air75"), list every keyboard of one size ("75%"), or leave both empty to list all of them. Returns each match with its size, width and depth in cm and inches, and a link to its review; if the query names a size instead of a keyboard, returns the typical size of that layout.

query.description: Keyboard name or part of it, e.g. "Wooting" or "Jet 75"

size.description: List only keyboards of this layout size.

name: get_keyboard_dimensions

standard_size.description: Present when the query names a size rather than a keyboard

compare_url.description: This size drawn to scale on HLPlanet

summary.description: Readable list of the keys, or "none"

reviews.description: HLPlanet reviews of keyboards in this size

title: Get keyboard dimensions
